senses.gloss:
प्रहणेमि प्रह-णेमि or प्रह-नेमि, इस्, m.
the moon (incorrect forms for ग्रह-नेमि, q. v.).

प्रहन् 1. प्र-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्,
to kill, slay.
2. प्र-हन् in अ-प्रहन्, q. v.

प्र-हणन, अम्, n. killing, slaying (Scholiast
on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 22).

प्र-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck, beaten (as a drum),
smitten, wounded, killed; repelled, repulsed, over-
come, defeated; spread, expanded; contiguous,
bounding, limitating; conversant with the principles
of science; learned, accomplished.
—प्रहत-मु-
रज, अस्, आ, अम्, having drums beaten, sounding
with the beating of drums.
प्र-हन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed or slain.

प्र-हन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, striking down, slaying,
a slayer.
प्रहर प्र-हर, &c. See प्र-हृ, col. 3.

प्र-हर, अस्, m. a particular division of time
(comprising about three hours, = 6 or 7 Nāḍikas; so
called from its lapse being announced by beating a
gong); the eighth part of a day, a watch [cf. अर्ध-
प्˚]; a subdivision of Śrī-vasanta-rāja's work entitled
Śākuna.
—प्रहर-कुटुवी, f. a species of plant
(= कुटुम्बिनी).
—प्रहर-विरति, इस्, f. the end of
a watch; (औ), ind. at the end of the (morning)
watch, at nine o'clock in the forenoon.
प्रहार प्र-हार. See प्र-हृ, col. 3.

प्र-हार, अस्, m. striking, hitting; a stroke,
blow, slap, knock, thump [cf. तल-प्˚, मुष्टि-प्˚];
a kick [cf. पाद-प्˚]; a cut, thrust [cf. खड्ग-प्˚];
killing, wounding; pecking; shooting, hitting (with
a missile), a shot, hit.
—प्रहार-करण, अम्, n.
dealing blows, beating. -प्रहार-वर्मन्, आ, m.,
N. of a prince of Mithilā.
—प्रहार-वल्ली, f. =
चर्म-कशा, मांस-रोहिणी.
—प्रहारार्त (˚र-
आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, bruised or wounded by a blow,
hurt by a blow; (अम्), n. chronic and acute pain
from a wound or hurt.
प्रहर्ष प्र-हर्ष, &c. See प्र-हृष्, col. 3.

प्र-हर्ष, अस्, m. extreme joy, hilarity, mirth,
gladness, delight, rapture, exultation, thrill; erection
of the male organ, priapism; प्रहर्षं कृ, to
take pleasure or delight in (with loc.)
—प्रहर्ष-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, delighted, glad.

प्रहस् प्र-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -हसितुम्,
to break out into laughter, laugh heartily, laugh at,
laugh; to mock, deride, ridicule.
प्र-हस, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa.

प्र-हसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, laughing heartily, laugh-
ing, smiling; (अन्ती), f. Arabian jasmine (= यूथी,
वासन्ती); a large chafing-dish or fire-pan.

प्र-हसन, अम्, n. laughing loudly, violent or
hearty laughter, laughing, mirth, merriment; laugh-
ing at, mocking, deriding, ridicule, irony, mockery;
sarcasm, satire (as a branch of rhetorical composi-
tion); a kind of comedy, a farce.

प्र-हसित, अस्, आ, अम्, laughing, cheerful; (अम्),
n. laughter, mirth.
—प्रहसित-नेत्र, अस्, m.
‘laughing-eyed,’ N. of a Buddha.
प्र-हासित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to laugh.

प्र-हसित्वा, ind. an anomalous form for प्र-
हस्य below.
प्र-हस्य, ind. having smiled or laughed.

प्र-हासक, अस्, m. one who causes laughter or
merriment, a jester.

प्र-हासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, laughing aloud, causing
laughter, diverting, joking, jesting; satirical; (ई),
m. the buffoon of a drama (= वि-दूषक, q. v.).

प्रहस्त प्र-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having long
hands; (अस्), m. the open hand with the fingers
extended; N. of a Rākṣasa; of a companion of
Sūrya-prabha (see Kathā-sarit-s. XLIV. 25).

प्रहस्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, scil. तृच, an epithet of
the verses Ṛg-veda VIII. 86, 13 — 15.

प्रहा 1. प्र-हा, cl. 3. P. -जहाति, -हातुम्,
to forsake, desert, leave, quit, abandon; to depart
from; to throw, cast, fling: Pass. -हीयते, to be for-
saken or relinquished, to be neglected; to fail, be
lost, perish, disappear, vanish; to cease.

2. प्र-हा, f., Ved. a good throw at dice, gain,
winnings; an advantage; (Sāy. = प्र-हन्तृ, a
smiter, as if fr. 1. प्र-हन्.
—प्रहा-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, Ved. acquiring gain, gaining; (Sāy. = प्रह-
रण-वत्, dealing blows, smiting.)

प्राह प्राह, अस्, m. instruction in the art
of acting or dancing.

प्र-हाण, अम्, n. relinquishing, abandoning,
omitting, avoiding.

प्र-हाणि, इस्, f. relinquishing, abandoning; want,
deficiency.

प्राहणि प्राहणि, इस्, m. a wrong reading
for प्रावाहणि, q. v.

प्र-हापण, अम्, n. driving away, forced aban-
donment or departure.

प्र-हीण, अस्, आ, अम्, left, abandoned; (अस्), m.
removal, loss, waste, destruction.
—प्रहीण-जीवित,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has abandoned life, dead, slain.
प्रहीण प्र-हीण. See 1. प्र-हा above.

प्रहि 1. प्र-हि, cl. 5. P. -हिणोति, -हेतुम्, to
send forth, dispatch, send to (with dat. or gen. or
acc. of the person and acc. of the thing); to shoot
(an arrow from a bow), send, cast, throw, discharge;
(Ved.) to rouse up, urge on (?); to propitiate (?).

प्रहि 2. प्रहि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. प्र-
हृ), a well.

प्र-हाय्य, अस्, m., Ved. ‘one who is to be sent,’
a messenger; [cf. प्र-हेय.]

1. प्र-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see below), sent
forth, sent, dispatched; shot, discharged (as an arrow
from a bow); appointed, commissioned [cf. अ-प्˚];
गौरीवितेः प्रहितः, N. of a Sāman; (अम्), n.
sauce, gravy, condiment.
—प्रहितन्-गम, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. going on an errand or mission.

प्र-हेति, इस्, m. a missile weapon (Ved., according
to Mahī-dhara = प्रकृष्टम् आयुधम्); N. of a
king of the Rākṣasas; N. of an Asura.
प्रहेति प्र-हेति, &c. See 1. प्र-हि, p. 651.

प्र-हेतृ, ता, m. one who sends forth; one who
excites or impels.

प्र-हेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sent away or dis-
patched, serving as a messenger.

प्रहिम प्र-हिम, see Scholiast on Pāṇ.
VIII. 4, 16.

प्रहुत प्र-हुत, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हु with प्र),
sacrificial food offered to all created beings; (अम्),
n. an offering of food to all created beings (= भूत-
यज्ञ, Manu III. 74).

प्र-हुति, इस्, f., Ved. an oblation, sacrifice; (Sāy.
= प्रकृष्टाहुतिः, an excellent oblation.)
प्र-होष, अस्, m., Ved. an oblation, sacrifice (?).

प्रहोष प्र-होष, प्रहोषिन्. See p. 651,
col. 3.

प्रहोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. offering oblations or
sacrifices.

प्रहृ प्र-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्-
तुम्, to strike at, strike, beat; to wound, hurt,
injure; to attack, assail, assault; to cast, throw,
fling, hurl (with dat. or acc.); to seize upon; (with
पादेन) to kick; (Ved.) to offer, present.
प्रहरक, अस्, m. striking the hours; a watch.

प्र-हरण, अम्, n. striking, beating; casting,
throwing; attacking, assailing, assaulting; fighting,
war, battle; repelling, removing, expelling; a
weapon, (कृत-प्रहरण, practised in the use of
arms, cf. कृतास्त्र); the box of a carriage; a
covered car, litter, small covered pleasure-car, (in
this sense incorrectly for प्र-वहण, q. v.); (अस्),
m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa.
—प्रहरण-कलिका or
प्रहरण-कलिता, f. a kind of metre, four times
˘˘˘˘˘˘¯˘˘˘˘˘˘¯.

प्र-हारण, अम्, n. a desirable gift; (a various
reading for प्र-वारण, q. v.)

प्र-हरणिय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attacked or
assailed, assailable; to be fought with; to be expelled
or removed; (अम्), n. a weapon.

प्रहरिन्, ई, m. ‘one who announces the hours
by striking a bell, beating a gong, &c.,’ a watchman,
sentry; a bellman.

प्र-हरिष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, intending to
strike; wishing to take.

प्र-हर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be struck; to be
attacked or assailed, assailable.

प्र-हर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, striking, a striker; one
who beats; fighting, a fighter, assailant, combatant,
champion; one who shoots, a shooter, archer.

प्र-हारुक, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. carrying off, tearing
away.

प्र-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be beaten, deserving
to be beaten; to be taken away, to be removed.

प्रहृष् प्र-हृष्, cl. 4. P. -हृष्यति, -हर्-
षितुम्, to rejoice beforehand, be glad in anticipation,
anticipate pleasure; to be very glad, rejoice exceed-
ingly, exult: Caus. -हर्षयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
be glad, gladden, cheer, inspirit, encourage, delight.

प्र-हर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing erection of the
hair of the body, causing a thrill of joy; making
glad, gladdening; delighting; delighted, happy;
(अस्), m. the planet Mercury or its ruler [cf. प्र-
हर्षुल]; (ई), f. turmeric, (a various reading
for प्र-हर्षिणी); a kind of metre, four times
[]
¯¯¯, ˘˘˘˘¯˘¯˘¯¯; (अम्), n. joy, delight;
the act of making glad or rejoicing; the attainment
of a desired object.

प्र-हर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly delighted, de-
lighted, very happy.

प्र-हर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing gladness, gladden-
ing; (इणी), f. turmeric [cf. प्र-हर्षणी]; a kind
of metre, = प्र-हर्षणी.

प्र-हर्षुल, अस्, m. the planet Mercury; [cf.
प्र-हर्षण.]

प्र-हृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly pleased,
overjoyed, rejoiced, delighted, happy, joyful, glad.
—प्रहृष्ट-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, delighted at
heart, rejoiced in mind, exceedingly glad.
—प्र-
हृष्ट-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, of pleasing form; erect
in form.
—प्रहृष्ट-रोमन्, आ, m. ‘having brist-
ling hair,’ N. of an Asura.
—प्रहृष्टात्मन् (˚ट-
आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, delighted in soul, rejoiced in mind.
प्रहृष्टक, अस्, m. a crow.

प्रहेलक प्र-हेलक, अम्, n. (fr. rt. हिल् with
प्र), a riddle, enigma; a kind of pastry; sweet-
meats &c. distributed at festivals (= प्र-हेणक).

प्र-हेला, f. playful dalliance, loose or free be-
haviour; प्रहेलया, sportively, freely, without con-
striant.

प्र-हेलि, इस्, or प्रहेलिका, f. an enigma, riddle,
puzzling or enigmatical question.

प्रह्राद प्र-ह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ह्राद् with
प्र), N. of the chief of the Asuras with the patro-
nymic Kāyādhava (the father of Vi-rocana); N. of
a son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu (he was an enemy of Indra
and friend of Viṣṇu; cf. प्र-ह्लाद).

प्राह्राद प्राह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-ह्राद),
a patronymic of Vi-rocana.

प्रह्रादि, अयस्, m. pl. the attendants of the
Asura Pra-hrāda.

प्राह्रादि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Vi-rocana and
of Bali.

प्रह्रास प्र-ह्रास, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ह्रस् with
प्र), shortening, decrease; languishing, fading away.

प्रह्लाद् प्र-ह्लाद्, cl. 1. A. -ह्लादते, -ह्लादि-
तुम्, to be delighted: Caus. -ह्लादयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to rejoice, gladden, delight, exhilarate; to
extinguish (?).

प्र-ह्लत्ति, इस्, f. pleasure, happiness, joy; (less
correctly for प्र-ह्लन्नि.)
प्र-ह्लन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, glad, happy.
प्र-ह्लन्नि, इस्, f. pleasure, delight, happiness.

प्र-ह्लाद, अस्, m. joyful excitement, pleasure,
joy, happiness; sound, noise; N. of a pious Daitya
(son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu; he was remarkable for his
devotion to Viṣṇu, and was on this account perse-
cuted by his father; he was made king of the
Daityas by Viṣṇu, and was regent of one of the
divisions of Pātāla, cf. प्र-ह्राद and see Viṣṇu-
Purāṇa I. 17); N. of a Nāga; of a Prajā-pati;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.

प्र-ह्लादक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing joy or pleasure,
refreshing.

प्र-ह्लादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to rejoice,
gladdening, delighting.
प्र-ह्लादित, अस्, आ, अम्, rejoiced, delighted.

प्र-ह्लादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing joy, delighting;
refreshing.

प्रह्व प्र-ह्व, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ह्वृ with
प्र), bent forwards, inclined, sloping, slanting;
bent, bowed, stooping; bowing humbly, humble,
modest; inclined towards, intent upon, devoted to,
attached to, engrossed by, engaged in; (ई), f., N.
of a Śakti.
—प्रह्वाञ्जलि (˚व-अञ्˚), इस्, इस्, इ,
stooping or bowing with the palms of the hands
[]
joined and put to the forehead in token of respect.
—प्रह्वी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, bent forwards, bowed,
bent; subjected, conquered, won.
प्र-ह्वण, अम्, n. bowing down in reverence.

प्र-ह्वाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bent forwards, bent,
bowed, stooping.

प्रह्वल् प्र-ह्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ह्वलति, -लितुम्,
to stagger forwards, quake, tremble.

प्रह्वलीका प्र-ह्वलीका, f. an incorrect form
for प्र-वल्हिका, q. v.

प्रह्वे प्र-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते,
-ह्वातुम्, to call to, call upon, call, summon, invoke.

प्र-ह्वाय, अस्, m. calling, summoning, invoking,
invocation.

प्राह् प्राह् (प्र-अह्, see 3. अह्), only in
Perf. प्राह, to utter, express; to announce, pro-
claim, declare, state, tell, speak, say (with acc. of
the thing and dat. or acc. of the person); to record,
hand down by tradition; to call, name; to consider
or regard as.

प्राहारिक प्राहारिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-हार),
a police officer, constable (?).

प्राहृतायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-
hṛta.

प्राहुण प्राहुण, अस्, ई, m. f. a guest (=
प्राघुण).
प्राहुणक, अस्, m. = प्राहुण.
प्राहुणिका, f. a female guest.

प्राह्ण प्राह्ण (fr. प्र + अह्न), अस्, m. the
early part of the day, forenoon, morning; (अम्, ए),
ind. in the forenoon, in the morning.
—प्राह्णे-
तमाम्, ind. very early in the forenoon.
—प्राह्णे-
तराम्, ind. earlier in the forenoon, very early in
the morning.

प्राह्णेतन, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to
the forenoon, happening in the morning, matutinal.
